plot_review: The folded discovery plot contains three similarly shaped dips separated by roughly one third of the 2.36-day trial period. The search also found 0.78675-day and 1.57281-day peaks. This motivates alias/eclipsing-binary checks; it does not identify the host or prove a binary. There is a large observing gap. Eight events support the refined 2.358248-day clock.
host_attribution: Neighbor contamination favored; crowded source not uniquely identified.
